nano-ui (@kizmann/nano-ui) — Vue 3 component library for desktop
applications, with drag-and-drop as a flagship feature. AI-agent-facing docs
generated from source at commit 0ff05b4a37867486c8d7e3655ed05477cd0f886b on
2026-08-20. Generated directly from src/ and demos/ — NOT derived from
docs/ or any other pre-existing documentation in this repo.

If a prop/behavior you observe in actual source contradicts these docs,
treat the docs as stale rather than silently trusting either side — flag it
instead of guessing which one is right.

Read first:
- concepts.md      Controller/Data/View pattern, ProtoController/ProtoData/
                    ProtoView API, shared Props mixins, open-string type/size
                    rule, options ($index/$value) resolution, v-model rules.
- setup.md         install, module vs global usage, themes, webpack alias.
- config.md        App.use(Install,...) options are inert; NConfig explained.
- icons.md         icon prop = pass-through Font Awesome string; Styler
                    override mechanism for nano-ui's own internal icons.
- theming.md        CSS custom properties (--n-color-*, --n-size-*), themes.
- patterns.md      5 realistic multi-component compositions.
